summary: TechCreate Group Ltd., a Singapore-based technology consultancy listed on OTCMKTS and facing NYSE American delisting proceedings, furnished a Form 6-K reporting first-half fiscal 2026 results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Revenue fell to roughly S$880,000 (US$680,000) from S$1.9 million, on completed Brunei and Cambodia projects, contract expirations, and weaker QR soundbox terminal sales; cost of revenue declined to S$579,000. The filing also notes a Committee for Review hearing scheduled October 22, 2026, board and committee changes effective May 31, 2026, and the CFO/CAO appointment. This is a routine earnings and corporate-update filing, not a special situation.
